description:
Validate a Dutch KVK number (Handelsregister)

Quick validation check: is a KVK number registered and active?
Returns simple true/false. Local cache (48 hours) serves repeated requests.
When the source is temporarily unavailable we return HTTP 503.

Cost: 0.1 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: validation.kvk
